WARDEN.description: A gigantic ancient stone golem guardian speaking fluent native Japanese, male monster bass. Extremely deep subterranean chest resonance, a broad hollow stone-cavern timbre, rough rocky vocal folds, crushing authority and huge physical mass. Steady deliberate commands with hard clear consonants. Stern, threatening, battle-ready, never a soft narrator. Controlled low growl under the words, no high-pitched rasp, no cartoon or comical delivery. Natural Japanese intonation. Dry isolated studio speech, no music or background effects, no echo. Preserve intelligibility; the voice itself feels enormous.
